description: This file defines the CategoryRepository class, responsible for managing CRUD operations and queries on the 'categories' table in a SQLite database within a Flutter application. It provides methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving categories, as well as checking if a category is of income type.

classes.name: CategoryRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing categories in the database, singleton pattern used for instantiation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new category record into the database and returns the category model with assigned id.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing category identified by its id. Returns true if the update affected any rows.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a category by id from the database. Returns true if a row was deleted.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its id, returns null if not found.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves all categories, optionally filtering by type, ordered by name case-insensitively.

methods.name: isIncomeCategory
methods.description: Checks if a given category id corresponds to an income category.
